title: First-line immunochemotherapy for advanced NSCLC in Asian patients: a meta-analysis of phase 3 RCTs.

answer.design_quote: Six databases were systematically explored to locate applicable phase 3 RCTs. Eligible studies involved Asian patients with stage IIIb–IV NSCLC and compared PC treatment with conventional chemotherapy.
answer.k_quote: A total of 16 phase 3 RCTs involving 4,452 Asian patients were included.
